description: Output of rag_validation Step 4. Ground truth is label_weighted_coverage (falls back to weighted_coverage for legacy JDs). MAE is importance-weighted using Phase 9 section_importance_factor. Cross-references JD Phase 13 mathematical_validation.

section_accuracy.description: Per-section accuracy percentage comparing AI (hybrid × weight) against ground truth (label_weighted_coverage × weight)

ground_truth_scores.description: Deterministic ground truth score per section = label_weighted_coverage × weight / 100

ai_scores.description: AI-generated score per section = hybrid_score × weight

importance_weighted_mae.description: Importance-weighted MAE: Σ(section_importance_factor × |ai − gt|) / Σ(section_importance_factor). Uses Phase 9 factors. Falls back to flat MAE when no importance factors are present.

rmse.description: Root Mean Square Error (currently equal to flat MAE)

total_weight_checked.description: Sum of all section weights processed

jd_weights_math_valid.description: Cross-reference of jd_weights.weighting_metadata.mathematical_validation.is_valid (Phase 13 output). False means the JD weight pipeline itself flagged a math error — propagated to rag_final_verdict and score_adjustment.
